# Zombie Cleaner TikTok Scene Plan

## Scene 1
- Name: Hook Danger
- Duration: 0.0s - 2.0s
- Purpose: Stop the scroll instantly with threat and mystery
- Visual: Quick close cuts of a robotic gloved hand with a revolver and white mechanical legs stepping onto a dusty ruined street
- On-screen text: Zombie cleanup starts now.
- Voiceover: Zombie cleanup starts now.

## Scene 2
- Name: Character Reveal
- Duration: 2.0s - 5.0s
- Purpose: Lock in the main character silhouette and attitude
- Visual: Full-body hero reveal of the cowboy robot standing in the middle of an abandoned retro-futuristic resort boulevard
- On-screen text: Meet the cleaner.
- Voiceover: Meet the cleaner.

## Scene 3
- Name: World Plus Creature Setup
- Duration: 5.0s - 8.0s
- Purpose: Establish the world and tee up the absurd payoff
- Visual: Wide ruined luxury boulevard with blood-stained road and vintage cars, then a quick strange close-up of a mutated ostrich
- On-screen text: Not a horse.
- Voiceover: Not a horse.

## Scene 4
- Name: Mount Reveal
- Duration: 8.0s - 12.0s
- Purpose: Deliver the first major comedy-action surprise
- Visual: The cowboy robot mounts a giant ostrich in the middle of the zombie boulevard
- On-screen text: Way better.
- Voiceover: Way better.

## Scene 5
- Name: High-Speed Ride
- Duration: 12.0s - 17.0s
- Purpose: Provide the strongest action payoff and prove motion quality
- Visual: Side tracking shot of the cowboy robot riding the giant ostrich at high speed through the ruined zombie city while the background streaks with motion blur
- On-screen text: Fast. Weird. Perfect.
- Voiceover: Fast. Weird. Perfect.

## Scene 6
- Name: LED Face Attitude Beat
- Duration: 17.0s - 21.0s
- Purpose: Turn the protagonist from a cool visual into a memorable character
- Visual: Medium close-up of the robot riding fast while the LED face mask shows a playful icon and the jacket flutters
- On-screen text: Zero fear.
- Voiceover: Zero fear.

## Scene 7
- Name: Deadpan Pose
- Duration: 21.0s - 25.0s
- Purpose: Create shareable main-character energy through contrast and stillness
- Visual: Full-body shot of the robot adjusting its cowboy hat in the doorway of an abandoned store with mannequins framing the composition
- On-screen text: Main character energy.
- Voiceover: Main character energy.

## Scene 8
- Name: Sunset Ending Hook
- Duration: 25.0s - 30.0s
- Purpose: Leave a stylish aftertaste and invite episodic continuation
- Visual: Wide sunset shot of the cowboy robot and giant ostrich overlooking a ruined futuristic city
- On-screen text: Would you watch Episode 2?
- Voiceover: Would you watch Episode 2?
